text:
You need a front-end built from your Figma design for a USDT payment gateway checkout flow, with HTML/CSS/JavaScript and wallet integrations like Binance Pay, WalletConnect, and MetaMask.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I have 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS. I can turn your design into a clean, responsive 3–4 page checkout flow and integrate the wallet payment options smoothly into the frontend.

I focus on matching the design closely, keeping the code organized, and making the user flow simple and reliable. If you’d like, I can start by reviewing the Figma screens and outlining the implementation approach for the checkout pages and wallet connections.
